subject: Remove Unused Variables And Add `UnusedVar` Helper Template (#803)
reason: The change only removes dead local variables (lexer.cc, proximity.cc, test files) and marks still-performed loads as [[maybe_unused]] (index_schema.cc keeps the LoadObject<bool>() call, so the serialization stream is consumed identically). No command reply, indexing, persistence, or replication behavior differs between the parent and the change; the remaining hunks touch unit tests only. A compared sequence could not show any difference, so no scenario is needed.
